sources.name: members.eriechamber.org
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Read 10 November 2026. The Erie Chamber of Commerce runs its calendar on ChamberMaster/GrowthZone. One machine-readable feed exists, /feed/rss/UpcomingEvents.rss (the feedUrl, recorded so nobody looks for it again): 200, application/rss+xml, the next 10 events only (9 to 20 November), each title with the date in front ('11/13/2026 - Karaoke Night!') and no date, time or venue element, the same shape as Windsor's chamber feed, which ingest cannot read; type stays html. The month pages /events/calendar/2026-11-01 and /2026-12-01 read as plain HTML (robots.txt allows them; it disallows /events/search). November lists 30 entries and December 15. Many are outside Erie (Winner's Circle and Axe Me Out in Longmont, Josephine Commons in Lafayette, a yoga studio in Louisville), so each needs its address checked. In Erie, 10 November to 10 December, worth a row, 4: The Read More Holiday Market at Orchard Community Church, 470 Briggs Street (21 November, 10 am to 7 pm), Tiny Art Show at Fox Dog Coffee, 515 Briggs Street (29 November, 5 to 8 pm, Co-Create Erie), Parade of Lights (4 December, activities from 4:30 pm, parade 6:30 pm, already in the guide) and the Chamber Holiday Open House (9 December, RSVP). Regulars: Friday karaoke at The Dugout, 149 S Briggs Street (5 Fridays). Never: Business Connections, Coffee Connections, The A Team, Business After Hours, Erie Health & Wellness Alliance. Exclusions if a reader is ever written: Business Connections, Coffee Connections, The A Team, Business After Hours, Wellness Alliance, Discover the Chamber, Karaoke. www.eriechamber.org (WordPress) has no Events Calendar route (wp-json/tribe/events/v1 answers 404).

sources.name: highplains.libcal.com
sources.notes: Checked 4 October 2026: LibCal's public iCal (ical_subscribe.php?src=p&cid=8181) returns 500 events for the whole district beginning about a month back, so it never reaches the coming weeks, and no branch or date parameter changed that (cm, campus, lid, l, d tried); the RSS carries four items. Erie's events are read from the calendar by hand until a usable feed is found. Read 10 November 2026: a usable feed was found, recorded in feedUrl; the type is left html because the entry is confirmed and the owner turns it on. The calendar page links rss.php?iid=4057&m=month&cid=8181 (300 items for the whole district, 10 to 21 November). The branch parameter is cam, not campus: with &cam=4556 (the Erie Community Library's id in the page's branch list) the RSS answers 73 items, all campus 'Erie Community Library', dated 10 November to 10 December 2026, each with libcal:date, libcal:start, libcal:end, libcal:location and libcal:campus, which scripts/lib/feeds/rss.ts reads. &campus=4556 is ignored and m=3month answers empty. Worth a row, 14: Rebecca Thorne Author Talk (10 November), Mini Bookshelf and Origami Books (12 November), Centennial State Ballet presents The Nutcracker and Views of Nature (14 November), Explore our National Parks: Sand Creek Massacre (16 November), Luggage Tag 3D Design (18 November), Amazing Architecture Around the World (19 November), 3D Paper Design (23 November), Thankful Storytime and Craft (24 November), Wood Box Design and Wildfire in the West with the Space Science Institute (2 December), DIY Gifts K-2nd Grade (5 December), 'New To You' Kids Book Exchange (6 December), Paws to Study (8 December). Regulars, 58: the storytimes (Tales for Tots, Twinkle Babies, Family Storytime, Music & Movement, Adaptive Storytime), the book clubs, Threads, Mahjong Meetup, LEGO, Pokemon, Code Club, chess, Tales 2 Tails, Baby Open Play, Friends And Family Art Club, the D&D campaign. Never, 1: 'CLOSED FOR VETERAN'S DAY'. Exclusions if it is turned on: Storytime, Twinkle Babies, Music & Movement, Book Club, Book Dragons, Threads, Mahjong, LEGO Club, Pokemon, Code Club, Chess Club, Tales 2 Tails, Baby Open Play, Art Club, Dungeons, CLOSED, cancelled. Most of these dates are already in the guide by hand, so the first read needs a check for doubles. Robots: highplains.libcal.com's robots.txt has no Disallow for our agent, only 'Crawl-delay: 10' under User-agent: *. Typed rss 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3"): the LibCal RSS in feedUrl is now what ingest reads; robots.txt allows it. After the dry run of 10 November 2026: 73 items in 120 days, 21 already on the guide by hand; the weekly storytimes, baby and music sessions (38 of the 48 new) and the closure markers are excluded by title, as on the other library feeds. It also saw four published listings whose venue reads "Erie Community Library living room" where the feed says the library.

sources.name: theoldmine.com
sources.notes: Seeded 2026-10-04 from the sources the content cites. Category guessed from the host name; type html until a feed is found. Found and read 10 November 2026: a feed. The Old Mine is at 500 Briggs Street, Erie. Its events page (theoldmine.com/events, Squarespace) embeds a public Google Calendar, oldmine.calendar@gmail.com, whose iCal feed is the feedUrl. Fetched once: 139 items, 9 of them repeating, entered as far ahead as 3 February 2027. Dated 10 November to 10 December 2026 and worth a row, 5: the Wednesday music nights with a named act at 6 pm (Matt Adams on 18 November, Hoss & The Hangman on 25 November, Shawn Cunnane on 2 December, R&D Radio on 9 December) and Vanilla Bourbon Release Day on 27 November. Regulars, 7: trivia every Tuesday and the Bluegrass Jam on the second Thursday (12 November, 10 December), which the guide already lists by hand, so turning the feed on needs a check for doubles. Never: 'No Live Music' on 11 November, 'Closed For Thanksgiving', and a weekly all-day 'Brisket Sandwich Special'. No Sunday music or open mic was in the feed for these weeks although the page still names both. Exclusions suggested: TRIVIA, No Live Music, Closed, Brisket Sandwich Special. Robots: calendar.google.com's robots.txt is 'Allow: /$, Disallow: /', so the feed path is disallowed and reading it weekly needs the editor's robots: subscribe, as Niwot's Fritz Family Brewers did. The site's own robots.txt disallows ?format=json and ?format=ical; the page itself is allowed. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("Go 1 to 3", DECISIONS.md, "Twenty-four sources turned on"): robots: subscribe from the same day, the owner's call: the host's robots.txt disallows the path, and this is the calendar the organization publishes for subscription; one weekly read is what a subscribed calendar does.

sources.name: Erie High School (school event calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Erie High School is at 3180 County Road 5, Erie (St. Vrain Valley Schools). The home page ehs.svvsd.org embeds a Google Calendar agenda naming four calendars. The first, 'School Event Calendar' (svvsd.org_27ajla9cn99nv52ectmgs1i33k@group.calendar.google.com), is the feedUrl: fetched once, 200, 2,548 items with no repeating rules, entered into 2028. About 170 are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026 and nearly all are the school's day: A Day and B Day markers, club meetings by room, detention, practices, rehearsals, college visits, faculty meetings. Worth a row, 6: One Act Performances (13 November, doors 5 pm, show 5:30), SVVSD High School Honor Orchestra & Mariachi Festival Performance (19 November, 7 pm), EHS Winter Bands Concert (3 December, 7 pm), Winter Showcase (5 December, shows at 10:30 am, 12:30 pm and 4 pm), Winter Choir Concert (8 December), Winter Orchestra Concert (10 December). Also there and the editor's call: the feeder elementary choir concerts in the auditorium (Black Rock 10 November, Soaring Heights 2 December, Red Hawk 9 December), the EHS Band Mattress Sale fund raiser (15 November) and the school's Open House (18 November). Games are not on this calendar; the guide has athletics as a program. The exclusions listed keep the performances and drop the rest as read today; a first dry run should be looked at, since titles are free text. Of the other three calendars in the embed, two answer 404 as public iCal (c_mm55cdu30ih6er3ns1moer3i18@group and an imported one) and the third is the district calendar with nothing after December 2024. Robots: ehs.svvsd.org allows the page; calendar.google.com's robots.txt is 'Allow: /$, Disallow: /', so reading the feed weekly needs the editor's robots: subscribe, as the Frederick, Windsor and Severance high school calendars did.

sources.name: Erie Middle School (school calendar)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Erie Middle School is at 650 Main Street, Erie (St. Vrain Valley Schools). The home page ems.svvsd.org embeds one public Google Calendar (svvsd.org_jvafr657arkbdcf2c4psj6ma78@group.calendar.google.com), whose iCal is the feedUrl: fetched once, 200, 1,566 items, 155 of them repeating (weekly clubs and ensembles), entered to May 2027. 62 single items are dated 10 November to 10 December 2026, most of them outside clubs' gym practices (Erie Elite, Impact, Colorado Titans), robotics and meetings. Worth a row, 2 that are only here: EMS Talent Show (12 November, 6 pm) and EMS Drama Class Production (2 December, 6 pm). Three more are joint concerts held at Erie High School and also on its calendar (band 3 December, 7 pm; choir 8 December, 7 pm; orchestra 10 December), so with both feeds on they would double and their venue is not the default one. One home game: girls basketball against Coal Ridge Middle (2 December, 3:30 pm); away games carry 'Game @' in the title. A small source, a handful of rows a semester; the exclusions listed are from today's read and a dry run should be looked at first. Robots: ems.svvsd.org allows the page; calendar.google.com's robots.txt disallows the feed path, so it needs the editor's robots: subscribe.

Read today, worth a row, 3: Author Spotlight with KK Salathe (14 November, 11 am to 1 pm), the shop at the Westerly Holiday Market (21 November, 10 am) and Shop Small Saturday (28 November). December's picture was not up yet. Robots: the Shopify robots.txt allows pages and the image. Type manual: nothing here for ingest to read.

sources.name: Colorado Railbike Adventures (seasonal rides)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The Erie Chamber's directory gives the address as 4121 County Road 3, Erie; the guide has it as a place. Squarespace site, no events collection and no feed. The home page says 'Book Now for Haunted History and Illuminated Christmas Rides' and the Christmas page describes two seasonal runs: the Illuminated Christmas ride (a 2 mile round trip after dark through lit scenes, $212 a railbike for up to four riders, booking fees included) and a Daytime Christmas Ride (4.2 miles, Santa at select departures). The dates are not on the site's own pages: they are only in the FareHarbor booking calendar (fareharbor.com/embeds/book/coloradorailbikeadventures/), and fareharbor.com's robots.txt disallows /embeds/book/, so the calendar was not fetched and no count was made. One seasonal listing with a date range, to be read by a person from the booking calendar or asked of the operator. The site's own robots.txt allows the pages read.

sources.name: Co-Create Erie (makerspace classes and events)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. Co-Create Erie is a volunteer-run nonprofit opening Erie's first community makerspace at Schofield Farm Open Space, 2203 North 111th Street, Unit A, Erie; the home page says 'Coming Soon' in 2026. Its Classes, Events & Certifications page (a custom site, plain HTML, no feed or iCal found) lists one item today, worth a row: Tiny Art Show, Sunday 29 November, 5 to 8 pm, at Fox Dog Coffee, 515 Briggs Street, free, miniature works by Colorado artists for sale to fund the makerspace (also on the Erie Chamber calendar). Each item has its own page under /classes/. Worth watching monthly: the page has filters for classes and certifications that should fill once the space opens. Robots: robots.txt allows everything but /admin, /profile and /community.

sources.name: Erie Historical Society (Wise Homestead Museum)
sources.notes: Found and read 10 November 2026. The guide cites this site for three events, A Homestead Christmas at the Wise Homestead Museum on 12 December among them, and it had no registry entry. WordPress with The Events Calendar installed: the home page links /events/?ical=1 and /wp-json/tribe/events/v1/, and both answer, but empty (total 0 from 1 November 2026, and 0 when asked back to 2024; the iCal has no events). The society announces its events as ordinary pages (/a-homestead-christmas/), so there is nothing for ingest to read; type html, read by hand. Nothing dated 10 November to 10 December 2026 was found; the Homestead Christmas falls two days after. If the society ever enters its events in the plugin, the feed would be https://www.eriehistoricalsociety.org/wp-json/tribe/events/v1/events. Robots: robots.txt (Yoast) disallows nothing.

sources.name: Eventbrite, events in Erie
sources.notes: Proposed 10 November 2026, when the owner asked for a way to use Eventbrite. The place page is Eventbrite's search of the region around Erie, not of the town: 49 pages of twenty. The reader (scripts/lib/feeds/eventbrite.ts) takes the first five pages, one every two seconds, and the location filter keeps what is in Erie. Read that day: 99 events in five pages, 1 of them in town: Nov 23 Broker Education - "Metro Districts In Colorado" (2026-11-23, McStain Neighborhoods at Westerly). Eventbrite lists every organizer's events, so this is filed as other and its items wait for a person; classes and workshops are most of what a small town shows. robots.txt at www.eventbrite.com allows the page for ordinary agents (it disallows its internal /api/v3/destination/ search, which the reader does not use). Eventbrite's terms of service restrict automated collection of its pages; confirming this source is the owner's decision with that in mind. The event search API was shut in 2020, and the API that remains lists only the token holder's own events. Confirmed 10 November 2026 on the owner's word ("for all towns as well use eventbrite"), told that Eventbrite's terms restrict automated collection and that robots.txt allows the page. Still filed as other: its items wait for a person.
